note: Stable error codes (docs/ERROR-DIAGNOSTICS.md). Backend texts are English ASCII; the desktop shows the user text from its locale mask (desktop/locale/pt-BR.json) by error_code and params. {name} placeholders come from the producer's params. Module hints are investigation pointers, not proof of a defect.

EXCEL-NOT-FOUND.what: Excel desktop was not found on this machine.
EXCEL-NOT-FOUND.pending: No workbook was opened; the start step did not begin.
EXCEL-NOT-FOUND.next: Check that Excel desktop is installed and available for this user, then run the check again.
EXCEL-NOT-FOUND.details: Discovery returned NotFound. Precondition not met; module defect not confirmed.

EXCEL-DISCOVERY-FAILED.what: Could not check whether Excel is installed.
EXCEL-DISCOVERY-FAILED.completed: The installation query failed before finishing.
EXCEL-DISCOVERY-FAILED.pending: Whether Excel is installed is unknown; no workbook was opened.
EXCEL-DISCOVERY-FAILED.next: Try again. If it persists, copy the diagnostic and send it to support.
EXCEL-DISCOVERY-FAILED.details: Discovery query failed ({reason}). The failure was not converted to NotFound.

CONTRACT-EXCEL-DESCRIPTOR.what: The Excel discovery answer could not be used to start the workbook.
CONTRACT-EXCEL-DESCRIPTOR.completed: The answer was received, but the contract was rejected.
CONTRACT-EXCEL-DESCRIPTOR.pending: The start step was not run.
CONTRACT-EXCEL-DESCRIPTOR.next: Copy the diagnostic and send it to support. Repeating the same operation may not help.
CONTRACT-EXCEL-DESCRIPTOR.details: Incompatible descriptor at the discover -> start boundary ({reason}). Investigate producer, consumer or composition.

EXCEL-EXECUTABLE-MISSING.what: The Excel reported by discovery is no longer available.
EXCEL-EXECUTABLE-MISSING.completed: The descriptor was accepted, but the executable is missing at the given path.
EXCEL-EXECUTABLE-MISSING.next: Run the Excel check again; if Excel was removed or repaired, wait for it to finish and retry.
EXCEL-EXECUTABLE-MISSING.details: Executable missing at start time. The environment may have changed after discovery.

EXCEL-START-FAILED.next: Check that Excel opens manually for this user and try again.

EXCEL-START-TIMEOUT.what: Excel started but did not become ready in time.
EXCEL-START-TIMEOUT.completed: The Excel process was started (last observed state: {observed}).
EXCEL-START-TIMEOUT.pending: The new workbook was not confirmed.
EXCEL-START-TIMEOUT.next: Check the Excel window opened by this attempt and close it before trying again.
EXCEL-START-TIMEOUT.details: Readiness not confirmed within {timeout_ms} ms. Slowness and an unexpected dialog cannot be told apart without investigation.

EXCEL-START-SCREEN-UNRESOLVED.what: Excel opened on its start screen and the new workbook could not be created.
EXCEL-START-SCREEN-UNRESOLVED.completed: Excel was started; the command to leave the start screen ended as {engine_outcome}.
EXCEL-START-SCREEN-UNRESOLVED.pending: The new workbook was not confirmed.
EXCEL-START-SCREEN-UNRESOLVED.next: Check the Excel window opened by this attempt before repeating.

SESSION-UNAVAILABLE.what: The Windows session is not available for automation.
SESSION-UNAVAILABLE.completed: The session check finished before any action.
SESSION-UNAVAILABLE.next: Unlock this user's session and keep it connected, then run again.

SESSION-BUSY.what: Another automation is already using this session.
SESSION-BUSY.completed: The run was refused before any action.
SESSION-BUSY.next: Wait for the running automation to finish and run again.

RUNTIME-NOT-PRIVATE.what: RedRise internal components are not intact.
RUNTIME-NOT-PRIVATE.next: Use the installation repair option and try again.

ENGINE-MISSING.what: The RedRise automation engine was not found.
ENGINE-MISSING.next: Use the installation repair option and try again.

ENGINE-NO-RESPONSE.what: The automation engine did not answer as expected.
ENGINE-NO-RESPONSE.completed: The request was sent to the engine; the answer was not usable.
ENGINE-NO-RESPONSE.pending: The result of the operation is unknown.
ENGINE-NO-RESPONSE.next: Check what is on screen before running again.
ENGINE-NO-RESPONSE.details: Missing or invalid Engine answer ({reason}). This does not prove an engine defect.

JOB-ALREADY-EXISTS.what: This run was already done and is not repeated automatically.
JOB-ALREADY-EXISTS.pending: The previous result is still recorded ({prior_state}).
JOB-ALREADY-EXISTS.next: Check the previous result; to run again, create a new run.

JOB-INVALID.what: The run request received is not valid.
JOB-INVALID.completed: The request was refused before any action.
JOB-INVALID.next: Copy the diagnostic and send it to support.

PROCEDURE-INCOMPATIBLE.what: This routine is not compatible with this computer.
PROCEDURE-INCOMPATIBLE.completed: Compatibility was checked before any action.
PROCEDURE-INCOMPATIBLE.next: Run the routine on a station compatible with the stated category and system.

STEP-FAILED.completed: The failure happened before effectful actions ({failed_step}).
STEP-FAILED.pending: The remaining steps were not run.
STEP-FAILED.next: Check that the application was open and visible as expected and run again.

STEP-UNCERTAIN.what: The automation was interrupted after actions that may have changed something.
STEP-UNCERTAIN.completed: Part of the steps was sent to the application ({failed_step}).
STEP-UNCERTAIN.pending: Whether the last change was applied is unknown.
STEP-UNCERTAIN.next: Check the file or the screen before running again to avoid repeating changes.
STEP-UNCERTAIN.details: Engine: {engine_code}. Uncertain effect; no automatic retry.

RUN-INTERRUPTED-BY-INPUT.what: The automation stopped because the keyboard or mouse was used during the run.
RUN-INTERRUPTED-BY-INPUT.completed: RedRise stopped typing and clicking as soon as it noticed the use ({failed_step}).
RUN-INTERRUPTED-BY-INPUT.pending: The following steps were not run; what was already typed may have mixed with the other input.
RUN-INTERRUPTED-BY-INPUT.next: Check the file or the screen and run again without using the keyboard and mouse until the run ends.

RUN-CANCELLED.completed: The cancellation was applied between steps.
RUN-CANCELLED.pending: The following steps were not run; check what was already done.
RUN-CANCELLED.next: Check the application state before running again.

OUTPUT-EXISTS.what: The output file already exists and is never replaced.
OUTPUT-EXISTS.completed: The check was done before opening any application.
OUTPUT-EXISTS.pending: Nothing was written; the existing file was not changed.
OUTPUT-EXISTS.next: Choose another name or move the existing file and run again.

INPUT-INVALID.what: The data given to the routine is incomplete or incorrect.
INPUT-INVALID.completed: The check was done before any action.
INPUT-INVALID.next: Fix the indicated field and run again.

INPUT-FILE-MISSING.what: The given input file was not found.
INPUT-FILE-MISSING.completed: The check was done before opening any application.
INPUT-FILE-MISSING.next: Check the input file path ({path}) and run again.

RECORDING-EMPTY.what: The recording ended without any action recorded in the chosen application.
RECORDING-EMPTY.completed: The recording was closed; nothing was saved as a routine.
RECORDING-EMPTY.next: Record again using the keyboard and mouse in the chosen application. Automatic actions from other programs are not recorded.

RECORDING-INCOMPLETE.what: The recording did not finish correctly and cannot become a routine.
RECORDING-INCOMPLETE.completed: The recording was closed; nothing was saved as a routine.
RECORDING-INCOMPLETE.next: Record again. If it persists, copy the diagnostic and send it to support.

APP-NOT-INSTALLED.what: The application this routine needs was not found.
APP-NOT-INSTALLED.completed: The check was done before any action.
APP-NOT-INSTALLED.next: Install or make the application available for this user and run again.
APP-NOT-INSTALLED.details: Missing application: {app}. Precondition not met; module defect not confirmed.

APP-WINDOW-NOT-FOUND.what: The application was started, but its window did not appear.
APP-WINDOW-NOT-FOUND.completed: The application was started. Nothing was typed or saved.
APP-WINDOW-NOT-FOUND.next: Check whether the application opened a window or is asking for something, close it, and run again.

RESULT-NOT-VERIFIED.what: The automation finished, but the expected result was not confirmed.
RESULT-NOT-VERIFIED.completed: The steps were sent to the application.
RESULT-NOT-VERIFIED.pending: The independent check did not find the expected result ({reason}).
RESULT-NOT-VERIFIED.next: Check the file or the screen before running again.

LOGIN-REQUIRED.what: The site opened but asks you to sign in to your account.
LOGIN-REQUIRED.completed: The page was opened in the RedRise browser.
LOGIN-REQUIRED.pending: The inbox was not opened; RedRise never types passwords.
LOGIN-REQUIRED.next: In Settings, use Open RedRise browser, sign in manually and run again.

TEMPLATE-UNAVAILABLE.what: This routine template is not available in this version.
TEMPLATE-UNAVAILABLE.next: Choose another template or wait for a version that includes it.

CONTRACT-PAYLOAD.what: An internal RedRise answer came in an incompatible format.
CONTRACT-PAYLOAD.completed: The answer was received and rejected by validation.
CONTRACT-PAYLOAD.pending: The next step was not run.
CONTRACT-PAYLOAD.next: Copy the diagnostic and send it to support. Repeating the same operation may not help.
CONTRACT-PAYLOAD.details: Contract {contract} rejected ({reason}). The origin may be the producer, the consumer or the composition.

AUTH-REQUIRED.what: You need to sign in again.
AUTH-REQUIRED.completed: The request was refused before any change.
AUTH-REQUIRED.next: Sign in with your user and password and repeat the action.

AUTH-INVALID.pending: You are not signed in to RedRise.
AUTH-INVALID.next: Check user and password. If you forgot the password, ask a team administrator.

AUTH-RATE-LIMITED.what: Too many attempts in a short time.
AUTH-RATE-LIMITED.completed: The request was refused before the password or the form was checked.
AUTH-RATE-LIMITED.next: Wait {retry_after_s} seconds and try again. If you forgot the password, ask a team administrator.
AUTH-RATE-LIMITED.details: Attempt limit of the team server (wait {retry_after_s} s).

AUTH-FORBIDDEN.what: Your role does not allow this action.
AUTH-FORBIDDEN.completed: The request was refused before any change.
AUTH-FORBIDDEN.next: Ask a team administrator to do the action or change your role.

SETUP-ALREADY-DONE.what: This team already has an administrator.
SETUP-ALREADY-DONE.pending: The initial setup is not repeated.
SETUP-ALREADY-DONE.next: Sign in with an existing user.

NOT-FOUND.what: The requested item does not exist or is no longer available.
NOT-FOUND.next: Refresh the screen and choose the item again.

VALIDATION.what: The data sent is not valid.
VALIDATION.completed: The request was refused before any change.
VALIDATION.next: Fix the indicated field and try again.

CONFLICT.what: The action conflicts with the current state.
CONFLICT.next: Refresh the screen to see the current state before acting.

STATION-INCOMPATIBLE.what: The chosen station cannot run this routine.
STATION-INCOMPATIBLE.next: Choose a station compatible with the routine category and system.

CORE-STORAGE-UNAVAILABLE.what: The team server could not access its data.
CORE-STORAGE-UNAVAILABLE.pending: Whether the change was saved is unknown.
CORE-STORAGE-UNAVAILABLE.next: Wait a moment, refresh the screen and check before repeating.

CORE-INTERNAL.what: The team server hit an internal error.
CORE-INTERNAL.pending: Whether the change was completed is unknown.
CORE-INTERNAL.next: Refresh the screen and check before repeating. If it persists, copy the diagnostic and send it to support.

CORE-BUSY.what: The team server is busy with other requests.
CORE-BUSY.completed: The request was refused before anything was done.
CORE-BUSY.next: Wait a moment and try again.
CORE-BUSY.details: No request slot within the wait (retry after {retry_after_s} s).

SCHEDULE-NOT-STARTED.what: Not started: the station was busy or disconnected.
SCHEDULE-NOT-STARTED.completed: The scheduled run was cancelled before its first step began.
SCHEDULE-NOT-STARTED.pending: Nothing was done on the station for this occurrence.
SCHEDULE-NOT-STARTED.next: Check that the station is connected and free at the scheduled time; the next occurrence runs as planned.
SCHEDULE-NOT-STARTED.details: First step not started within the grace period of the scheduled time.

CORE-UNREACHABLE.what: Could not talk to the team server.
CORE-UNREACHABLE.completed: The connection did not complete or there was no answer in time.
CORE-UNREACHABLE.pending: If the action had already been sent, its result is unknown.
CORE-UNREACHABLE.next: Check that the server computer is on and on the same network; refresh the screen before repeating.
CORE-UNREACHABLE.details: {reason}. No answer does not prove a server failure.

CORE-CERT-MISMATCH.what: The server answered with an identity different from the expected one.
CORE-CERT-MISMATCH.completed: The connection was stopped before sending data.
CORE-CERT-MISMATCH.pending: Nothing was sent to the server.
CORE-CERT-MISMATCH.next: Ask the administrator for a new team connection code.

JOB-LEASE-LOST.what: The station stopped answering during the run.
JOB-LEASE-LOST.completed: The run had started on the station.
JOB-LEASE-LOST.pending: How far it went is unknown; the run is not repeated automatically.
JOB-LEASE-LOST.next: Check the result on the station (file or screen) before running again.
JOB-LEASE-LOST.details: Lease expired with the run in progress. May be network loss, shutdown or a hang; cause not confirmed.

STATION-NOT-JOINED.what: This computer is not connected to a team yet.
STATION-NOT-JOINED.pending: The station does not receive team runs.
STATION-NOT-JOINED.next: In Settings, connect the station with the team code and an administrator.

JOIN-CODE-INVALID.what: The team connection code is not valid.
JOIN-CODE-INVALID.completed: Nothing was sent to the server.
JOIN-CODE-INVALID.next: Copy the code shown on the team server computer again.

ENGINE-IR-COMPILE.what: The recording could not be turned into a routine.
ENGINE-IR-COMPILE.next: Check the given parameters (the text must have been typed during the recording) and try again.

UPDATE-CHANNEL-UNREACHABLE.completed: The installed version stays in use.
UPDATE-CHANNEL-UNREACHABLE.pending: The check will run again later.

UPDATE-INVALID.what: The offered update is not trusted and was ignored.
UPDATE-INVALID.completed: Nothing was installed; the current version and data are intact.
UPDATE-INVALID.pending: The update will not be applied.
UPDATE-INVALID.next: Tell support; do not install files received by other means.

UPDATE-DOWNLOAD.completed: The installed version stays in use.
UPDATE-DOWNLOAD.next: Try again later with Update now.

UPDATE-BUSY.what: The update is waiting: a run or recording is in progress on this station.
UPDATE-BUSY.next: Wait for it to finish and click Update now again.

UNMAPPED.what: An error without a specific description yet occurred.
UNMAPPED.completed: The operation state was not determined.
UNMAPPED.pending: Check what was done before repeating.
UNMAPPED.next: Copy the diagnostic and send it to support.

ROUTINE-NOT-ISOLATED.what: This routine cannot run on its own.
ROUTINE-NOT-ISOLATED.completed: The request was refused before anything was started.
ROUTINE-NOT-ISOLATED.next: Run the process that contains the routine ({routine}), or allow isolated execution in its registration.
ROUTINE-NOT-ISOLATED.details: Isolated execution is off for this routine; it needs the context of the previous routine in a process.

BROWSER-NOT-FOUND.what: The browser chosen for this routine was not found on the station.
BROWSER-NOT-FOUND.completed: The check was done before opening anything.
BROWSER-NOT-FOUND.pending: No page was opened; the next routines did not run.
BROWSER-NOT-FOUND.next: Install the browser for this user on the station, or edit the routine and choose a browser found there.
BROWSER-NOT-FOUND.details: Chosen browser: {browser}. No other browser is used in its place.

BROWSER-OPEN-FAILED.what: The page could not be opened.
BROWSER-OPEN-FAILED.completed: The opening request was refused by Windows.
BROWSER-OPEN-FAILED.pending: No page was opened; the next routines did not run.
BROWSER-OPEN-FAILED.next: Check that the browser or the file can be opened by this user and run again.

BROWSER-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.what: The opening of the page was not confirmed in time.
BROWSER-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.pending: No new tab showing the target was identified within 30 seconds; the next routines did not run.
BROWSER-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.next: Check the browser: a tab may have opened. It was left as it is. Run again only after checking.
BROWSER-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.details: Confirmation not observed ({reason}). Not repeated automatically.

BROWSER-PAGE-NOT-READY.what: The tab opened at the address, but the page was not confirmed as loaded.
BROWSER-PAGE-NOT-READY.completed: A new tab showing the target address was identified.
BROWSER-PAGE-NOT-READY.pending: The page did not load in time or the browser showed an error page; the next routines did not run.
BROWSER-PAGE-NOT-READY.next: Check the tab that was opened: it was left as it is. Check the address and the connection, then run again.
BROWSER-PAGE-NOT-READY.details: Page not ready ({reason}). Not repeated automatically.

BROWSER-IDENTIFY-UNAVAILABLE.what: The station cannot identify browser tabs right now.
BROWSER-IDENTIFY-UNAVAILABLE.completed: The check was done before opening anything.
BROWSER-IDENTIFY-UNAVAILABLE.pending: No page was opened; the next routines did not run.
BROWSER-IDENTIFY-UNAVAILABLE.next: Try again. If it persists, copy the diagnostic and send it to support.
BROWSER-IDENTIFY-UNAVAILABLE.details: UI Automation is unavailable ({reason}); a page is not opened without a way to confirm it.

IDENTITY-NOT-CONFIGURED.what: E-mail sign-in is not available in this installation.
IDENTITY-NOT-CONFIGURED.pending: The account service is not configured in this build.
IDENTITY-NOT-CONFIGURED.next: Use the team user sign-in, or install a build with the account service configured.

IDENTITY-PROVIDER-UNAVAILABLE.what: Could not reach the account service.
IDENTITY-PROVIDER-UNAVAILABLE.pending: The operation was not confirmed by the service.
IDENTITY-PROVIDER-UNAVAILABLE.next: Check the internet connection and try again.

IDENTITY-INVALID.pending: You are not signed in to RedRise.
IDENTITY-INVALID.next: Check the e-mail and password, or use the password recovery.
IDENTITY-INVALID.details: The account service refused the credentials.

IDENTITY-UNCONFIRMED.what: The e-mail of this account was not confirmed.
IDENTITY-UNCONFIRMED.pending: You are not signed in to RedRise.
IDENTITY-UNCONFIRMED.next: Open the confirmation message or ask for it again.
IDENTITY-UNCONFIRMED.details: Account without proof of e-mail possession.

IDENTITY-NO-MEMBERSHIP.what: This account is not part of this team yet.
IDENTITY-NO-MEMBERSHIP.pending: No access to the team was granted.
IDENTITY-NO-MEMBERSHIP.next: Enter the user and password you received from the team to link this account once, or ask a team administrator for a user.
IDENTITY-NO-MEMBERSHIP.details: No link between the account and a team member on this server.

IDENTITY-ALREADY-LINKED.what: This account or team user is already linked.
IDENTITY-ALREADY-LINKED.next: Sign in with the account already linked, or ask a team administrator to review it.
IDENTITY-ALREADY-LINKED.details: One account links to one team user.

IDENTITY-PASSWORD-WEAK.what: The account service did not accept this password.
IDENTITY-PASSWORD-WEAK.pending: Registration is pending a different password.
IDENTITY-PASSWORD-WEAK.next: Choose another password and try again.

IDENTITY-SIGNUP-BLOCKED.what: The account service did not complete the registration.
IDENTITY-SIGNUP-BLOCKED.pending: No confirmation message can be assumed.
IDENTITY-SIGNUP-BLOCKED.next: Try to sign in or ask for the confirmation again before repeating. If it persists, copy the diagnostic and send it to support.
IDENTITY-SIGNUP-BLOCKED.details: Service refused or changed the registration: {reason}.

IDENTITY-RATE-LIMITED.what: Too many attempts in a short time.
IDENTITY-RATE-LIMITED.completed: The request was refused by the account service.
IDENTITY-RATE-LIMITED.next: Wait a few minutes and try again.
IDENTITY-RATE-LIMITED.details: Rate limit of the account service.

IDENTITY-SESSION-EXPIRED.what: The remembered session is no longer valid.
IDENTITY-SESSION-EXPIRED.completed: The remembered session was removed from this computer.
IDENTITY-SESSION-EXPIRED.pending: You are not signed in to RedRise.

IDENTITY-VAULT-FAILED.what: The Windows vault could not be used.
IDENTITY-VAULT-FAILED.completed: You can keep working in this session.
IDENTITY-VAULT-FAILED.next: Check the Windows credentials service. Until then, sign in on every start.

ACCOUNT-EXISTS.what: This e-mail already has an account.
ACCOUNT-EXISTS.next: Sign in with this e-mail, or ask a team administrator to activate the account.
ACCOUNT-EXISTS.details: One account per e-mail in this team.

ROUTINE-LINKED.what: This routine is part of a process and runs through it.
ROUTINE-LINKED.completed: The request was refused before anything was started.
ROUTINE-LINKED.next: Run the process {process}, which contains this routine.
ROUTINE-LINKED.details: Linked routines run in the order of their process, with its context.

ROUTINE-IN-USE.what: This routine is part of a process and cannot be deleted.
ROUTINE-IN-USE.completed: The request was refused; the routine was not changed.
ROUTINE-IN-USE.pending: The routine stays in the list.
ROUTINE-IN-USE.next: Remove it from the process {process} first.
ROUTINE-IN-USE.details: A process cannot lose a routine it runs.

APP-TARGET-NOT-FOUND.what: The destination was not found on this station: {target}.
APP-TARGET-NOT-FOUND.completed: The check ended. Nothing was opened.
APP-TARGET-NOT-FOUND.pending: The routine cannot open this destination here.
APP-TARGET-NOT-FOUND.next: Choose another destination or install it on this station, then check again.
APP-TARGET-NOT-FOUND.details: The Start menu list and the file path are read on the station that runs.

APP-NO-ASSOCIATION.what: Windows has no program to open this file: {target}.
APP-NO-ASSOCIATION.completed: The check ended. Nothing was opened.
APP-NO-ASSOCIATION.pending: The routine cannot open this file here.
APP-NO-ASSOCIATION.next: Choose another file or set a program for this file type in Windows, then check again.

APP-OPEN-FAILED.what: Windows refused to open the destination: {target}.
APP-OPEN-FAILED.completed: The request to open was refused.
APP-OPEN-FAILED.next: Check that it opens by hand on this station, then try again.
APP-OPEN-FAILED.details: The Windows shell returned an error.

APP-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.what: Opening was requested, but no window of it was confirmed: {target}.
APP-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.completed: The request to open was accepted by Windows.
APP-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.pending: It may still open, or be hidden behind other windows.
APP-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.next: Look at the screen before trying again.
APP-OPEN-UNCONFIRMED.details: No new window or change of the foreground window was seen within the limit.

PREPARE-REQUIRED.what: This routine needs a successful preparation of its current version first.
PREPARE-REQUIRED.completed: The request was refused before anything was opened.
PREPARE-REQUIRED.next: Check the destination again in the assistant.
PREPARE-REQUIRED.details: A test opens only what a verified preparation resolved.

PROCESS-HAS-START.what: The process {process} already has a first step.
PROCESS-HAS-START.completed: The request was refused. The routine was not created.
PROCESS-HAS-START.pending: Nothing was changed in the process.
PROCESS-HAS-START.next: Choose a process without a first step, or create a standalone routine.
PROCESS-HAS-START.details: A process has at most one starting routine.

REVIEW-NOT-ASSIGNEE.what: Only the current responsible can approve this request.
REVIEW-NOT-ASSIGNEE.completed: The request was refused. Nothing was approved.
REVIEW-NOT-ASSIGNEE.pending: The execution stays waiting for review.
REVIEW-NOT-ASSIGNEE.next: Ask the responsible shown in the request, or change the responsible in the step of the routine.
REVIEW-NOT-ASSIGNEE.details: The responsible may have changed after the request was opened.

REVIEW-ALREADY-DECIDED.completed: The request was refused. The earlier decision stays.
REVIEW-ALREADY-DECIDED.pending: Nothing else to do on this request.
REVIEW-ALREADY-DECIDED.next: Refresh the screen to see who approved it and when.
REVIEW-ALREADY-DECIDED.details: A request has one decision and resumes the execution once.

STEP1-NEEDS-APPROVAL.what: Step 1 of a process is replaced only with approval.
STEP1-NEEDS-APPROVAL.completed: The request was refused. The process was not changed.
STEP1-NEEDS-APPROVAL.next: Use Replace step 1 in Processo > Acao.
STEP1-NEEDS-APPROVAL.details: Other steps can still be changed in the composition.

PROCESS-RUNNING.what: The process {process} has an execution in progress.
PROCESS-RUNNING.completed: The request was refused. The process was not changed.
PROCESS-RUNNING.next: Wait for the execution to end and try again.
PROCESS-RUNNING.details: Step 1 changes only while the process is not running.

CHANGE-PENDING-EXISTS.what: The process {process} already has a pending replacement of step 1.
CHANGE-PENDING-EXISTS.completed: The request was refused. No other request was opened.
CHANGE-PENDING-EXISTS.pending: The earlier request is still waiting for approval.
CHANGE-PENDING-EXISTS.next: Wait for its approval or cancel it.
CHANGE-PENDING-EXISTS.details: A process has one pending replacement at a time.

CHANGE-NOT-ELIGIBLE.what: Only an eligible member can approve this replacement.
CHANGE-NOT-ELIGIBLE.completed: The request was refused. Nothing was changed.
CHANGE-NOT-ELIGIBLE.pending: The replacement is still waiting for approval.
CHANGE-NOT-ELIGIBLE.next: Ask a member linked to the process or an administrator.
CHANGE-NOT-ELIGIBLE.details: Who requested it approves only when nobody else is eligible.

CHANGE-ALREADY-DECIDED.completed: The request was refused. The earlier decision stays.
CHANGE-ALREADY-DECIDED.pending: Nothing else to do on this request.
CHANGE-ALREADY-DECIDED.next: Refresh the screen to see who decided it and when.

REPORT-WRITE-FAILED.what: The report could not be saved: {target}.
REPORT-WRITE-FAILED.completed: Nothing was left in the folder of reports.
REPORT-WRITE-FAILED.pending: The execution stopped here; the next steps did not run.
REPORT-WRITE-FAILED.next: Check that the Documents folder of the station can be written, then run the process again.
REPORT-WRITE-FAILED.details: Reports are saved under Documents, RedRise, Relatorios.

REPORT-NOT-VERIFIED.what: The saved report could not be confirmed: {target}.
REPORT-NOT-VERIFIED.completed: A file may be in the folder of reports.
REPORT-NOT-VERIFIED.pending: The execution stopped here; the next steps did not run.
REPORT-NOT-VERIFIED.next: Open the file before running again.
REPORT-NOT-VERIFIED.details: What was read back differs from what was written, and the file could not be removed.

REPORT-NOT-HERE.what: The report {name} is not on this computer.
REPORT-NOT-HERE.pending: The report stays where it was saved.
REPORT-NOT-HERE.next: Open the Documents folder of the station that ran it, under RedRise, Relatorios.
REPORT-NOT-HERE.details: Reports are saved on the station that runs the step.

NOTIFY-LOGIN-REQUIRED.what: The webmail {target} asks for sign-in in this browser, so the draft does not exist yet.
NOTIFY-LOGIN-REQUIRED.completed: A tab of the webmail is open. Nothing was sent.
NOTIFY-LOGIN-REQUIRED.pending: The execution stopped here; the next steps did not run.
NOTIFY-LOGIN-REQUIRED.next: Sign in to the account in that browser, then run the process again.
NOTIFY-LOGIN-REQUIRED.details: RedRise never signs in to accounts.

NOTIFY-UNCONFIRMED.what: The draft was requested but not confirmed: {target}.
NOTIFY-UNCONFIRMED.completed: A tab or window may have opened.
NOTIFY-UNCONFIRMED.pending: The execution stopped here; the next steps did not run. Nothing was sent.
NOTIFY-UNCONFIRMED.next: Look at the screen before running again.
NOTIFY-UNCONFIRMED.details: The webmail tab did not show the expected address within the limit.

NOTEPAD-CONTEXT-MISSING.what: This step did not receive the window and tab of the run.
NOTEPAD-CONTEXT-MISSING.completed: Nothing was typed, saved or closed by this step.
NOTEPAD-CONTEXT-MISSING.pending: This step and the next ones did not run.
NOTEPAD-CONTEXT-MISSING.next: Run the whole process again from the first step.
NOTEPAD-CONTEXT-MISSING.details: Context from the previous step is missing ({reason}).

NOTEPAD-TABS-UNAVAILABLE.what: This version of the Notepad shows no tabs.
NOTEPAD-TABS-UNAVAILABLE.completed: The Notepad may have been opened, but nothing was typed.
NOTEPAD-TABS-UNAVAILABLE.pending: The process stopped at the first step.
NOTEPAD-TABS-UNAVAILABLE.next: Use the Notepad of Windows 11 with tabs, then run again.

NOTEPAD-TAB-NOT-IDENTIFIED.what: The tab for this run could not be identified.
NOTEPAD-TAB-NOT-IDENTIFIED.completed: A new tab was requested in the Notepad; nothing was typed.
NOTEPAD-TAB-NOT-IDENTIFIED.pending: The next steps did not run.
NOTEPAD-TAB-NOT-IDENTIFIED.next: Check the Notepad: a tab that was created stays as it is and your tabs were not changed. Then run again.

NOTEPAD-TARGET-LOST.what: The window or tab of this run was lost, so the step stopped before acting.
NOTEPAD-TARGET-LOST.completed: This step stopped before typing, saving or closing.
NOTEPAD-TARGET-LOST.pending: The next steps did not run.
NOTEPAD-TARGET-LOST.next: Check the Notepad: what was already there stays as it is. Then run the process again.
NOTEPAD-TARGET-LOST.details: Target check failed ({reason}). Not repeated automatically.

NOTEPAD-TEXT-MISMATCH.what: The editor did not show the text that was typed.
NOTEPAD-TEXT-MISMATCH.completed: The text was typed in the tab of this run; nothing was saved.
NOTEPAD-TEXT-MISMATCH.pending: The file was not saved and the next steps did not run.
NOTEPAD-TEXT-MISMATCH.next: Check the tab of this run, which stays open, then run again.

NOTEPAD-FILE-MISMATCH.what: The saved file does not have the expected content.
NOTEPAD-FILE-MISMATCH.completed: A file was saved on the Desktop.
NOTEPAD-FILE-MISMATCH.pending: The result was not verified and the next steps did not run.
NOTEPAD-FILE-MISMATCH.next: Check the file on the Desktop before running again.

NOTEPAD-SAVE-UNCONFIRMED.what: It could not be confirmed that the file was saved.
NOTEPAD-SAVE-UNCONFIRMED.completed: The save was requested in the Notepad; the result is unknown.
NOTEPAD-SAVE-UNCONFIRMED.pending: The next steps did not run.
NOTEPAD-SAVE-UNCONFIRMED.next: Check the Desktop and the Save As dialog before running again, so nothing is repeated.
NOTEPAD-SAVE-UNCONFIRMED.details: Save not confirmed ({reason}). Not repeated automatically.

NOTEPAD-CLOSE-CHANGES.what: The tab of this run has changes the run did not make, so it was not closed.
NOTEPAD-CLOSE-CHANGES.completed: The file was already saved; the tab stays open.
NOTEPAD-CLOSE-CHANGES.pending: The tab and the window remain open.
NOTEPAD-CLOSE-CHANGES.next: Check the tab and close it yourself if you no longer need those changes.

NOTEPAD-CLOSE-UNCONFIRMED.what: It could not be confirmed that the tabs closed as expected.
NOTEPAD-CLOSE-UNCONFIRMED.completed: The file was already saved; closing was requested.
NOTEPAD-CLOSE-UNCONFIRMED.pending: The final state of the window is unknown.
NOTEPAD-CLOSE-UNCONFIRMED.next: Check the Notepad before running again.
NOTEPAD-CLOSE-UNCONFIRMED.details: Close not confirmed ({reason}). Not repeated automatically.

ACCOUNT-SELF-DEACTIVATE.what: You cannot deactivate the account you are signed in with.
ACCOUNT-SELF-DEACTIVATE.completed: The request was refused; the account was not changed.
ACCOUNT-SELF-DEACTIVATE.next: Another administrator can deactivate this account, if needed.
ACCOUNT-SELF-DEACTIVATE.details: The account of the current session is never deactivated by itself.

ACCOUNT-ACTIVE.what: An active account cannot be deleted.
ACCOUNT-ACTIVE.completed: The request was refused; the account was not changed.
ACCOUNT-ACTIVE.pending: The account stays in the team with its access.
ACCOUNT-ACTIVE.next: Deactivate the account first, then delete it.
ACCOUNT-ACTIVE.details: Only an inactive account can be deleted; the state is read again when deleting.

STATION-IN-USE.what: This is the station this session is using.
STATION-IN-USE.completed: The request was refused; the station was not changed.
STATION-IN-USE.next: Revoke or delete it from another station of the team.
STATION-IN-USE.details: The station of the current session is identified by its own credential at sign-in.

STATION-SESSION-UNBOUND.what: This session is not tied to a station of the team.
STATION-SESSION-UNBOUND.completed: The request was refused; no station was changed.
STATION-SESSION-UNBOUND.pending: Revoking and deleting stations stay unavailable in this session.
STATION-SESSION-UNBOUND.next: Sign out and sign in again in the RedRise app of a connected station.
STATION-SESSION-UNBOUND.details: Without the proof of the station in use, the Core cannot protect it from being revoked.

STATION-NOT-REVOKED.what: Only a revoked station can be deleted.
STATION-NOT-REVOKED.completed: The request was refused; the station was not changed.
STATION-NOT-REVOKED.pending: The station stays in the list.
STATION-NOT-REVOKED.next: Revoke the station first, then delete it.
STATION-NOT-REVOKED.details: The state is read again when deleting.

PROCESS-START-INVALID.what: The process {process} cannot start as it is composed.
PROCESS-START-INVALID.completed: The request was refused before anything was started.
PROCESS-START-INVALID.next: Edit the process so that step 1 is a routine that starts it (not a follow-up), then run it again.
PROCESS-START-INVALID.details: Reason: {reason}. A follow-up needs the context of a step before it.
